outputs.", "w01": "The salt-crusted lighthouse keeper, Elias, was mending rotting wooden gallery slats on a gray, wind-whipped October afternoon when he spotted a glass bottle tangled in kelp at the He slipped the note into his coat, walked to the jetty, and set a granite stone atop the small weathered cairn already waiting there.", "w02": "凌晨四点的城市褪去了白日的燥热与喧嚣，柏油路面还留着白日余温蒸腾出的薄薄湿气。沿街路灯晕着暖黄柔光，偶尔有晚归的代驾骑手骑电动车静静驶过，车轮碾过落叶发出细碎声响。远处早点铺卷帘门拉开，暖白灯光漏出来，蒸包子的白汽顺着窗沿飘到街上，混着路边绿化带草木的清香气。立交桥下的流浪猫蜷成一团，在纸箱里打着轻鼾，整座城市正慢腾腾苏醒，等着第一波赶早的行人涌上来。", "w03": "- Recursion is when you solve a big problem by breaking it into smaller, identical versions of the same problem, like counting a stack of books one at a time until you reach the bottom.\n- It always needs a clear stopping rule, so you don’t keep going forever—like knowing you’re done once you count the very last book in the stack.\n- Each small step uses the answer from the last smaller step, so by the time you work back up, you have the answer to your original big question."}
